latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Easily deploy custom Uniswap pools on a local testnet with configurable parameters for controlled agent testing.

- Deploys V2 or V3 pools with chosen tokens, price, fee, liquidity, and tick range.
- Resolves token addresses/symbols, sets up initial liquidity, and auto-funds test accounts.
- Handles price-to-tick math, token sorting, and selects defaults for sensible edge-case testing.
- Includes built-in error handling and next-step guidance after pool creation.
- Requires a running local testnet; suggests setup if not detected.
